description: Use when an agent needs to know how the biggest Hyperliquid traders are positioned. Returns the open perp positions of the largest Hyperliquid accounts aggregated per coin: net long or short USD, account counts, size-weighted entries, notional-weighted distance to liquidation, notional within 10% of liquidation and uPnL. With coin=BTC: whale liquidation levels in 5% price bands and the largest positions. Refreshed every 5 minutes; stale data answers 503. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

coin.description: one Hyperliquid perp, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE: adds liquidation bands and the top positions

top.description: coins (or positions with coin=) returned, 1-50, default 20
